text:
zoe: onboarding customer hit a nasty output-shape mismatch. function/tool calls in json-mode are arriving as quoted strings after an auth-refresh retry during streaming.
rick: suspected double-stringify but want the minimal repro.
zoe: repro: 1) start streaming tool call with json-mode (preserveFormatting=true) 2) auth token refresh triggers retry while buffer holds raw chunks 3) retry replay currently replays rawText and upstream does JSON.stringify -> consumer sees '"{\"value\":42}"' instead of {"value":42}.
emily: ouch. what's the buffered representation?
zoe: node buffer entries include an informal object like {type: 'chunk', format: 'json', rawText: '...'}, but python kept buffer_tokens without a format tag. parity gap.
chris: proposal: add explicit format metadata to stream buffers (format: 'json'|'text') and expose a materializeAsObject() helper so retry can choose structured vs raw replay. explicit beats heuristic JSON.parse in retry code.
emily: also propose an SDK helper API: normalizeToolPayload(schema, { mode: 'strict'|'coerce'|'preserveFormatting' }) which validates/coerces or preserves raw text per policy. that centralizes logic for both node+py.
rick: add a parity harness: an integration test that uses an auth-mock to simulate mid-stream refresh and asserts consumer receives an object when preserveFormatting=false. run in CI for both runtimes.
zoe: opened a temporary PR that guards retry to check for a format tag before deciding to stringify: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-app/pull/1203 (label: hotfix).
infra-bot: created issue #2902: "streaming retry: buffer format metadata & normalizeToolPayload SDK helper" assigned to @emily
chris: test checklist: unit tests for buffer.format metadata, a backwards-compat shim for older buffers, integration auth-refresh replay test, and docs update in sample-app showing preserveFormatting caveat.
emily: i'll own python parity and the normalizeToolPayload spec. rick take node harness?
rick: taking node. i'll add node+browser tests and the CI matrix entry. aim to land before next sample-kit release so onboarding isn't flaky.
zoe: thanks — customer unblocked with the hotfix but want the real helper and parity tests to prevent future onboarding friction :thumbsup:
